response.justification: Bogdan is an exceptionally skilled software engineer with 20 years of diverse experience and strong fundamentals in design, testing, and architecture. However, the role requires deep C++ expertise (only 6 months of professional experience in his background), industrial automation and IoT domain knowledge (not present), and security standards like IEC 62443 (not demonstrated). While his ability to transition across technologies is impressive, the specialized technical requirements and manufacturing domain expertise are fundamental gaps.
strengths: 20 years of proven software engineering excellence with strong fundamentals in TDD, clean architecture, design patterns, and low-latency systems optimization
Relevant technology exposure including event-driven architectures, REST APIs, Node.js, TypeScript, React, and concurrent programming with async I/O patterns
Demonstrated mentoring capability, excellent communication skills, and commitment to knowledge-sharing through workshops, talks, and prolific open-source contributions
concerns: Critically limited C++ professional experience (6 months at National Instruments) against a role requiring senior-level C++ and STL expertise as the core competency
No background in embedded systems, industrial automation, IoT applications, or industrial protocols (Modbus TCP/IP, IEC 61850, IEC 104, OPC UA, DNP 3.0)
No demonstrated knowledge of Secure Development Lifecycle, IEC 62443 standards, or industrial cybersecurity practices—non-negotiable for manufacturing domain
